text_en: On that day they read from the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and in it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter the assembly of God,
text_cn: 那日，当着民众宣读《梅瑟书》时，人们听到书中写着说：“永远不准阿孟人和摩阿布人，加入天主的会众，

text_en: because they did not meet the Israelites with bread and water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them—yet our God turned the curse into a blessing.
text_cn: 因为他们没有携带饮食欢迎以色列子民，反贿赂巴郎诅咒他们，我们的天主却将诅咒转为祝福。”

text_en: When the people heard the law, they separated from Israel all those of foreign descent.
text_cn: 民众一听了这法律，便将各外族由以色列人中隔绝。

text_en: Now before this, the priest Eliashib, who was appointed over the chambers of the house of our God, and who was related to Tobiah,
text_cn: 这事以前，厄肋雅史布司祭，曾被派管理我们天主圣殿的仓库，他是托彼雅的亲信，

text_en: prepared for Tobiah a large room where they had previously put the grain offering, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of grain, wine, and oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, singers, and gatekeepers, and the contributions for the priests.
text_cn: 遂为托彼雅准备了一所大仓房，以前其中是存放供物、乳香、器具，以及肋未人、歌咏者和守门者按法律所应得的什一之谷、酒和油，并司祭所应得的供物。

text_en: While this was taking place I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of King Artaxerxes of Babylon I went to the king. After some time I asked leave of the king
text_cn: 发生这一切事时，我不曾在耶路撒冷、因为在巴比伦王阿塔薛西斯三十二年，我已回到君王那里； 满了一个时期以后，我又求得君王准许，

text_en: and returned to Jerusalem. I then discovered the wrong that Eliashib had done on behalf of Tobiah, preparing a room for him in the courts of the house of God.
text_cn: 回了耶路撒冷；此时我才发觉出，厄肋雅史布为托彼雅所行的坏事，为他在天主圣殿的庭院中，准备了一所大仓房。

text_en: And I was very angry, and I threw all the household furniture of Tobiah out of the room.
text_cn: 我感觉十分难受，立即将托彼雅的一切器物，抛出仓房之外，

text_en: Then I gave orders and they cleansed the chambers, and I brought back the vessels of the house of God, with the grain offering and the frankincense.
text_cn: 下命清洁那仓房，将天主圣殿的器具、供物和乳香仍放在里面。

text_en: I also found out that the portions of the Levites had not been given to them; so that the Levites and the singers, who had conducted the service, had gone back to their fields.
text_cn: 我还发觉肋未人应得之分，人们已不缴纳，为此供职的肋未人和歌咏者，各回了本乡。

text_en: So I remonstrated with the officials and said, “Why is the house of God forsaken? ” And I gathered them together and set them in their stations.
text_cn: 我便责斥首长们说：“为什么又将天主的圣殿忽略了呢？”以后我将肋未人召集起来，又恢复了他们的职务。

text_en: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, wine, and oil into the storehouses.
text_cn: 那时，全犹大又将什一之谷、酒和油送入仓房。

text_en: And I appointed as treasurers over the storehouses the priest Shelemiah, the scribe Zadok, and Pedaiah of the Levites, and as their assistant Hanan son of Zaccur son of Mattaniah, for they were considered faithful; and their duty was to distribute to their associates.
text_cn: 我派定了舍肋米雅司祭、匝多克经师和肋未人培达雅，作管理仓库的人；委任玛塔尼雅的孙子，匝雇尔的儿子哈南，作他们的助手，都是忠实可靠的人；他们的职务是将什一之物，分给他们的兄弟。

text_en: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and do not wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God and for his service.
text_cn: 我的天主，为了这事，请记忆我！不要抹去我对我天主的圣殿，和其中的礼仪所做的一切善事。

text_en: In those days I saw in Judah people treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in heaps of grain and loading them on donkeys; and also wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day; and I warned them at that time against selling food.
text_cn: 那时我在犹大，看见有人在安息日踏榨酒池，搬运禾捆，驮在驴上，并把酒、葡萄、无花果和其他各种重载，在安息日运到耶路撒冷；为了他们在此日买卖应用品，我曾警戒了他们。

text_en: Tyrians also, who lived in the city, brought in fish and all kinds of merchandise and sold them on the sabbath to the people of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 有住在这里的提洛人，运来鱼和各种货物，安息日还在耶路撒冷卖给犹太人，

text_en: Then I remonstrated with the nobles of Judah and said to them, “What is this evil thing that you are doing, profaning the sabbath day?
text_cn: 我遂责斥有权势的犹太人说：“你们怎么行这样的坏事，亵渎安息日呢？

text_en: Did not your ancestors act in this way, and did not our God bring all this disaster on us and on this city? Yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the sabbath. ”
text_cn: 你们的祖先不是曾这样行事，而使我们的天主，加给了我们和这城这一切灾祸吗？现今你们亵渎安息日，还要义怒再多加在以色列人身上吗？”

text_en: When it began to be dark at the gates of Jerusalem before the sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut and gave orders that they should not be opened until after the sabbath. And I set some of my servants over the gates, to prevent any burden from being brought in on the sabbath day.
text_cn: 所以在安息日前一天，阴影一来到耶路撒冷城门，我就下令关闭城门，不准开门，直到安息日过去；并派我的仆役守门，安息日不准任何重载运进。

text_en: Then the merchants and sellers of all kinds of merchandise spent the night outside Jerusalem once or twice.
text_cn: 有一两次，贩夫和卖各种货物的商人，在耶路撒冷外过夜；

text_en: But I warned them and said to them, “Why do you spend the night in front of the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you. ” From that time on they did not come on the sabbath.
text_cn: 我警告他们说：“你们为什么在城垣前过夜？若是你们再这样做，我就要向你们下手，”从此以后，安息日他们不敢再来。

text_en: And I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves and come and guard the gates, to keep the sabbath day holy. Remember this also in my favor, O my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your steadfast love.
text_cn: 我也命令肋未人先圣洁自己，然后去看守城门，为圣化圣日。我的天主，为了这事也请你记忆我！照你的大仁慈怜恤我！

text_en: In those days also I saw Jews who had married women of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab;
text_cn: 那时，我还发现好些犹太人，娶了阿市多得、阿孟和摩阿布人的女子为妻。

text_en: and half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod, and they could not speak the language of Judah, but spoke the language of various peoples.
text_cn: 他们的儿子，有一半只会说阿市多得话，或这些民族的一种语言，而不会讲犹太话。

text_en: And I contended with them and cursed them and beat some of them and pulled out their hair; and I made them take an oath in the name of God, saying, “You shall not give your daughters to their sons, or take their daughters for your sons or for yourselves.
text_cn: 我遂责斥咒骂这样的男人，其中一些我还打了他们，扯了他们的头发，叫他们指着天主起誓，向他们说：“你们不可再把你们的女儿，嫁给他们的儿子，也不可再为你们的儿子并为你们自己，娶他们的女儿。

text_en: Did not King Solomon of Israel sin on account of such women? Among the many nations there was no king like him, and he was beloved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel; nevertheless, foreign women made even him to sin.
text_cn: 以色列的君王撒罗满，岂不是在这事上犯了罪吗？在这样多民族中，没有一个相似他的君王，他又是天主所爱的，天主使他成为全以色列的君王，但是外方女子竟引他犯了罪。

text_en: Shall we then listen to you and do all this great evil and act treacherously against our God by marrying foreign women? ”
text_cn: 我们岂能任凭你们行这一切大坏事，娶外方妇女，背弃天主吗？”

text_en: And one of the sons of Jehoiada, son of the high priest Eliashib, was the son-in-law of Sanballat the Horonite; I chased him away from me.
text_cn: 大司祭厄肋雅史布的儿子约雅达，有个儿子是曷龙人桑巴拉特的女婿，我便驱逐他离开我。

text_en: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, the covenant of the priests and the Levites.
text_cn: 我的天主，请记住他们！因为他们亵渎了司祭的品位，破坏了司祭和肋未的誓约。

text_en: Thus I cleansed them from everything foreign, and I established the duties of the priests and Levites, each in his work;
text_cn: 如此我清除了一切异类，整顿了司祭和肋未人的职守，规定了各人应尽的任务，

text_en: and I provided for the wood offering, at appointed times, and for the first fruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
text_cn: 划定了奉献木柴和什一之物的时期。我的天主！求你记忆我，使我蒙福！
